Distribution multilayer and UI implementation plan

  1. Add a Via-only audit mode to the batched SPD same-NET reachability pass and use it to distinguish unchanged-via proof from the selected planning contract.
  2. Add Distribution-only retained-artwork indexing across every valid PWR layer, evaluate exact same-XY landing overlap under the documented via re-termination/reroute assumption, and project direct/shared-pad eligibility without changing Evaluation's plane pair.
  3. Reproduce the named workbook shortfall, add focused planner regressions, then verify the corrected plan against actual landing coordinates and plane artwork.
  4. Add the detached Distribution table, strict XLSX round trip, and display-only Original/Distributed board toggle with GUI tests.
  5. Run focused and full tests, offscreen UI/UX checks, and real-file replay.
  6. Bump the visible application version, build/smoke-test the desktop executable and installer, commit only in-scope files, push, and publish verified assets.
